hints.title: Detect Plus and Minus Tokens
hints.text: Each operation contains either two plus signs or two minus signs.

hints.title: Sub-character Check
hints.text: Checking if plus symbol is included in the operation string uniquely identifies an increment.

hints.title: Simulation Accumulation
hints.text: Initialize accumulator to zero and increment by one if plus is present else decrement by one.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N) iterating through N operations of length three
complexity.whyNaiveFails: No naive pitfall, direct simulation suffices.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should provide concise linear scan logic.
